quotes.replyTo: Is the Evo SL worth full retail?
quotes.text: Half my club has stopped reading launch coverage entirely — the algorithm rewards rage-bait reviews now. The group chat is the only honest filter left.
quotes.author: Priya N.

quotes.replyTo: The death of the brand ambassador
quotes.text: The athletes I respect most quietly stopped posting. They DM, they pace club runs, they show up at 6am. The performance is exhausting.
quotes.author: Sofia Alvarez

quotes.text: Nobody in this server bought the last three colorways at retail. We're all watching the same two resale bots and pretending that's a community.
quotes.author: Marcus Webb

quotes.text: The pacer-only drop got the whole chat talking again. First time a release felt like it was for us, not for the resellers.
quotes.author: Dayo A.

quotes.text: Carbon plates stopped being a flex. The flex now is showing up to a Tuesday session in whatever's already broken in.
quotes.author: Jonas K.

quotes.text: We measured it: one club captain seeding a shoe converts better than an entire out-of-home campaign. Community is the channel.
quotes.author: Elena Marsh

quotes.replyTo: Rotation check: what's actually getting miles?
quotes.text: Everyone here owns the same six shoes. What we argue about is who actually runs in theirs.
quotes.author: gravelghost

quotes.text: Vote's in: half the group wants the retro colours back. The new stuff photographs well but the old stuff gets worn.
quotes.author: Nia T.
